data.body: Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 1228 (branch rebarbot/quiesce-novote, commit bce60494d9). Change 1: DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS 45->1200 (= review timeout), compose stop_grace_period 150s->1320s (1200+60+45=1305 rounded up); the source-derivation test passes unmodified. Change 2: adapter decisions carry machine-readable gap_reason; voter defers vote-less for review-error/llm-unavailable/scanner/gate-disabled with REVIEW_RETRY_DEFERRED marker; new review_attempts ledger in dedup.py (record/count/reset=DELETE, shaped for bb9b); escalation to fail-closed -1 with retries-exhausted note + VOTER_ERROR at RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3, env-overridable; docs/env-vars.md regenerated); indeterminate/finding/merge-path stay terminal; cast votes clear the budget. Module-size: emit_code_review_artifact + marker helpers extracted to artifact_emit.py along the existing best-effort seam (voter.py was 813/800 post-change; now 669 + 169). docs/review-policy.md documents the retryable/terminal split. Validation: review-bot suite 75 passed, affected modules 113 passed, make lint + typecheck green. Awaiting LLM-Review/Verified on 1228.
